title: prompt.template_ref node config (N-2, safety class: optional)
description: Picker semantics only — no inline editing. Deliberately carries NO `content` field: `additionalProperties: false` rejects one. The interpreter resolves `promptTemplateId` through PromptResolutionService at run time and serves the pinned APPROVED version, never the mutable `content` column — snapshotting content here would freeze an unapproved body into every future run.
